description: This file declares functions and external references related to invoking text editors within a git-related context, handling environment and buffer management, and providing an interface for editing files interactively.

methods.name: git_editor
methods.description: Returns the user's preferred editor command string for general editing tasks.

methods.name: git_sequence_editor
methods.description: Returns the editor command string specific to sequence editing in git.

methods.name: is_terminal_dumb
methods.description: Determines if the current terminal is a dumb terminal.

methods.name: launch_editor
methods.description: Launches the user preferred editor to edit a file, filling the buffer with the file contents upon completion.

methods.name: launch_sequence_editor
methods.description: Launches the sequence editor, similar to launch_editor, but tailored for sequence files.

methods.name: strbuf_edit_interactively
methods.description: Writes out a file, clears the buffer, launches an editor for interactive editing, then reads back the content into the buffer and deletes the temporary file.
